Splitting up the sum and factoring out the constants, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\begin{aligned}{\int }_{-2}^{2}(3z+2)\,\text{d}z & =3{\int }_{-2}^{2}z\,\text{d}z+2{\int }_{-2}^{2}\,\text{d}z \\  & =3\cdot \frac{{z}^{2}}{2}{|}_{-2}^{2}+2z\,{|}_{-2}^{2} \\  & =3(\frac{{2}^{2}}{2}-\frac{(-2)^{2}}{2})+2(2-(-2)) \\  & =3\cdot 0+2\cdot 4 \\  & =8.\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$
